title: Great Holiday Crafting ideas
text: I subscribed to this through the Annie's site and received my first two last year. I got Covid-19 in January and lost my job, I am a nurse. I had months of rehab ahead of me because of the severity of my case and needed to cancel all my subscriptions. I had absolutely no problems canceling this one. I was sad to do so because these holiday boxes had everything I needed to put together the tops for the projects and being a quilter I have batting, backing and stabilizers in my stash. When I can afford this again I will subscribe again.
label: positive
